verdict.rationale: cubic documents automatic PR summaries that generate PR descriptions from code changes (cubic-docs-21, cubic-docs-57), configurable in cubic.yaml (cubic-docs-11) and enrichable with Notion context (cubic-docs-61). Its PR review UI groups changes, keeps each group's description beside the diff as you scroll (cubic-docs-43), and lets reviewers hide test files (cubic-docs-14) to orient on implementation changes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that summaries and walkthroughs are generated on every PR by default, in-depth docs on the grouped walkthrough (only a changelog mention; the description and sidebar docs sit in an archive section), and independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
